title: Reptile Traction Leash Safe Adjustable Beads Design Small Animal Traction Rope For Lizard Guinea Pig Hamster Green
body_html: 1、Polyester Rope: Reptile traction leash is made of high strength polyester rope, safe and durable, wearable, not easy to break. 2、Widely Applicable: Small animal leash for guinea pigs, lizards, hamsters, chinchillas, etc, suitable for indoor and outdoor pet walking. 3、Safe And Comfortable: This reptile traction rope has a comfortable feel and will not tighten the pet's throat or hurt the pet's skin. 4、Easy To Use: The lizard leash is designed with many colorful beads to tighten the leash, or you can put the beads on the top of the leash for easy grip. 5、Adjustable: Small animal leash can be adjusted freely according to the shape of your pet to loosen and tighten, long enough to use more flexible.Item Type: Reptile Traction LeashMaterial: Polyester Rope1 x Reptile Traction Leash
